mapper.sql: cost_dimension_key AS costDimensionKey,cost_scope_id AS costScopeId, warehouse_id AS warehouseId,store_id AS storeId,sku_id AS skuId,currency_code AS currencyCode, cost_quantity AS costQuantity,cost_amount_minor AS costAmountMinor, avg_unit_cost_minor AS averageUnitCostMinor,last_unit_cost_minor AS lastUnitCostMinor, last_cost_ledger_sequence AS lastCostLedgerSequence, last_inventory_ledger_sequence AS lastInventoryLedgerSequence,record_version AS recordVersion

cost_ledger_id AS costLedgerId,cost_ledger_sequence AS costLedgerSequence, inventory_ledger_id AS inventoryLedgerId,inventory_ledger_sequence AS inventoryLedgerSequence, warehouse_id AS warehouseId,sku_id AS skuId,currency_code AS currencyCode,movement_type AS movementType, quantity_before AS quantityBefore,quantity_delta AS quantityDelta,quantity_after AS quantityAfter, cost_amount_before_minor AS costAmountBeforeMinor,cost_amount_delta_minor AS costAmountDeltaMinor, cost_amount_after_minor AS costAmountAfterMinor,unit_cost_minor AS unitCostMinor, avg_unit_cost_after_minor AS averageUnitCostAfterMinor,valuation_method AS valuationMethod, cost_estimated AS costEstimated,variance_amount_minor AS varianceAmountMinor, source_type AS sourceType,source_id AS sourceId,source_line_id AS sourceLineId, source_sha256 AS sourceSha256,policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, reversal_of_cost_ledger_id AS reversalOfCostLedgerId,business_date AS businessDate,occurred_at AS occurredAt
mapper.select: SELECT policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,store_id AS storeId,warehouse_id AS warehouseId, cost_scope_type AS scopeType,currency_code AS currencyCode,quantity_scale AS quantityScale, cost_scale AS costScale,rounding_mode AS roundingMode,zero_quantity_mode AS zeroQuantityMode, effective_from AS effectiveFrom FROM inv_cost_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND effective_from<=#{effectiveAt} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,policy_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM inv_cost_balance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND cost_dimension_key=#{costDimensionKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM inv_cost_balance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND currency_code='CNY'
SELECT FROM inv_cost_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND inventory_ledger_id=#{inventoryLedgerId}
SELECT FROM inv_cost_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND cost_ledger_id=#{costLedgerId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity_delta),0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(l.cost_amount_delta_minor),0) AS amountMinor, COUNT(*) AS ledgerCount,COALESCE(MAX(l.cost_ledger_sequence),0) AS lastCostLedgerSequence, COALESCE(MAX(l.inventory_ledger_sequence),0) AS lastInventoryLedgerSequence, COALESCE((SELECT l2.avg_unit_cost_after_minor FROM inv_cost_ledger l2 WHERE l2.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l2.cost_dimension_key=#{costDimensionKey} ORDER BY l2.cost_ledger_sequence DESC LIMIT 1),0) AS lastUnitCostMinor FROM inv_cost_ledger l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.cost_dimension_key=#{costDimensionKey}
